ns2:course.label: Economic Found of Quality Sys
ns2:course.description: Introduction to total quality systems for planning, developing and manufacturing world-class products. Covers the economic foundations of total quality. Subjects covered include product value, cost, pricing, environmental quality, activity-based costing, design for assembly, organization structure, lead time, innovation, Taguchi methods, simulation-based significance testing, Strategic Quality Deployment, statistical process control and conjoint analysis. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: IE 300 or consent of instructor
